dct_description_sm: Advertising map covering Michigan and vicinity. Shows drainage, cities and towns, railroad land grant, and the railroad network emphasizing the main line. Information on bond sale by Winslow, Lanier & Co., N.Y., on the verso. Under construction by Continental Improvement Company, George W. Cass, President.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Contributors: G.W. & C.B. Colton & Co; Grand Rapids and Indiana Railroad Company
dct_subject_sm: Grand Rapids and Indiana Railroad Company--Maps
dct_title_s: Map showing the Grand Rapids & Indiana Railroad, and its connections
